brief:
# Assessment

Use transfer-repositories: it meets the requirement to keep the personal login. For GHES, use repository transfer documentation instead of assuming the GitHub.com workflow is available.

Direct personal-account conversion to an organization was deprecated on January 12, 2026.

Move work selectively migrates repositories while preserving the personal account.

Move work is unavailable on GitHub Enterprise Server.
